definitions.full: H4576. mader מַעְדֵּר noun [masculine] hoe Isa 7:25 , see foregoing. מָרֵא noun masculine lord ( מָר ᵑ7 , with מָרֵי ; Syriac , e. , , Egyptian Aramaic מרא (RÉS i. 361 ); Christian-Palestinian Aramaic , etc., Schulth Lex. 115 ; Old Aramaic Nabataean Palmyrene מר(אׅ (Lzb 316 ); compare proper name, of deity מרנא ( μαρνα ), god of Gaza, SAC 77 ; also Arabic man , Sabean מרא , man, lord Hom Chr 127; AA 293 RÉS:i. 454, 2); — lord: of God, construct שְׁמַיָּא Dan 5:23 , מַלְכִין מָרֵה 2:47 ; of king, suffix מָֽרְאִי Kt (as Nabataean, SAC l.c .; K § 58, 1 ), Qr מָרִי (as Palmyrene, SAC l.c .) 4:16 ; 4:21 .
